It is not: the only server for it is engine-api's /v1/property-nodes/{id}/flood-drainage/{study,refresh}, and in Property Explorer that route sits behind a paid PROPERTY entitlement on a session this staff product does not have. The operator resolved this on 2026-09-19 (add a direct server-side engine client), and that client is what this lane built -- so the premise was wrong and was repaired rather than inherited. (2) The dispatch presents the row as unblocked by D-12. D-12 is closed-partial: the app deploys from main, but the customer predicate is unmet -- app.smartcityos.io was NXDOMAIN when read, the DO hostname is masked to external clients, and it is carded G-171 as PLANNER-OWNED. The 'reached on the DO app' leg of this row's done-condition therefore depends on an operator action outside this lane. Neither contradiction is a reason to have skipped the work; both are reasons the close cannot say 'closed'.
